cubic_init.message0: initialize Cubic Core car encoder PPR %1 reduction %2 M0 phase %3 M1 phase %4
cubic_init.tooltip: One-tap init: 8 IO lights, I2C bus (100kHz), 4 servos, encoder-motor PWM, OLED. Put it first in setup.

cubic_ps3_begin.tooltip: Start the Bluetooth host and wait for the controller. Use "auto" for this board's MAC (printed on serial), or the paired MAC.

cubic_ps3_connected.tooltip: Whether the PS3 controller is connected

cubic_on_connect.tooltip: Runs once when the controller connects

cubic_on_disconnect.tooltip: Runs when the controller disconnects (already auto-stops; add your handling here)

cubic_stick.tooltip: Read a stick value -127..127, with built-in deadzone and direction correction (push up = positive).

cubic_button.tooltip: Whether the button is currently held down (stays true)

cubic_button_pressed.tooltip: True only on the instant the button is pressed (rising edge); good for toggles/triggers.

cubic_stop_all.tooltip: Stop the encoder motors and all I2C motors.

cubic_i2c_motor.tooltip: Control a single I2C motor. Speed 0-255.

cubic_i2c_all.tooltip: All four I2C motors same direction and speed. Speed 0-255.

cubic_servo.tooltip: Move one servo to the given angle 0-180.

cubic_servo_all.tooltip: Move all 4 servos to the given angle 0-180.

cubic_oled_clear.tooltip: Clear the display buffer (does not refresh). Text shows only after a refresh.

cubic_oled_text.tooltip: Draw text into the buffer (coordinate is the text lower-left). Needs a refresh block to show.

cubic_oled_refresh_full.tooltip: Push the whole screen at once. Holds the bus ~90ms; use for static screens/boot only, not while driving fast.

cubic_oled_refresh_stream.tooltip: Put in loop. Sends only 1/8 screen per call, interleaved with motor commands to keep motors real-time. ~8 calls per full frame.

cubic_oled_logo.tooltip: Show the built-in Cubic Core boot logo (full refresh).

cubic_set_deadzone.tooltip: Stick values whose absolute value is below this are treated as 0, default 30.

cubic_invert_axis.tooltip: Invert a stick axis if its direction is reversed.

cubic_oled_pixel.tooltip: Draw a pixel in the buffer. Needs a refresh block to show.

cubic_oled_line.message0: OLED line from X %1 Y %2 to X %3 Y %4
cubic_oled_line.tooltip: Draw a line in the buffer. Needs a refresh block.

cubic_oled_rect.message0: OLED rectangle X %1 Y %2 W %3 H %4 %5
cubic_oled_rect.tooltip: Draw a rectangle (outline/filled) in the buffer. Needs a refresh block.

cubic_oled_circle.tooltip: Draw a circle (outline/filled) in the buffer. Needs a refresh block.

cubic_oled_num.tooltip: Write a number at the coordinate (lower-left). Needs a refresh block.

cubic_oled_font.tooltip: Set the font size for following text/numbers (small 6x10 / medium 7x13 / large 10x20).

cubic_oled_color.tooltip: Set draw color: on = set pixels, off = erase, xor = invert.

cubic_oled_power.tooltip: Turn the screen on or enter power save (display off, buffer kept).

cubic_oled_flip.tooltip: Flip the screen content 180° (turn on if mounted upside down).

cubic_enc_run_speed.tooltip: Closed-loop speed control, -300..300 RPM (encoder feedback + PID).

cubic_enc_speed.tooltip: Read the current speed of the encoder motor (RPM).

cubic_enc_pulse.tooltip: Read the accumulated encoder pulse count.

cubic_enc_revolutions.tooltip: Read the number of revolutions turned.

cubic_enc_pid.message0: encoder motor %1 set PID P %2 I %3 D %4
cubic_enc_pid.tooltip: Tune the speed-loop PID (default P3 I1 D1; adjust if closed loop is unstable).

cubic_key.tooltip: Whether one of the 3 onboard buttons (shared GPIO0 ADC) is pressed.

cubic_key_pressed.tooltip: True on the instant an onboard button is pressed (rising edge).

cubic_battery.tooltip: Read the battery voltage (volts) via the IO32 divider.
